candidate_universe: Predeclared feasible three-phase service buses satisfying voltage, PCC-transformer, land/use, and interconnection screening before evaluation.

constraints: minimum number of distinct first-level feeder subtrees
no two sites with identical cut-incidence vector unless candidate scarcity is certified
deterministic_rule.feature_vector: For each candidate bus: April-only normalized J_I columns over predeclared top-K native line-phase cuts and H voltage sensitivities, phase incidence, root-path branch incidence, and source electrical distance.
deterministic_rule.objective: Lexicographically maximize: (1) minimum pairwise standardized sensitivity distance, (2) logdet of sensitivity Gram matrix plus epsilon I, (3) subtree entropy, (4) electrical-distance range.
deterministic_rule.precommit: Freeze candidate set, April feature hashes, normalization, K, epsilon, constraints, solver seed, and selected sites before May/June access.
deterministic_rule.tie_break: ascending canonical bus ID then phase mask

selection_data_firewall.allowed: training period plus April validation D-1 feeder anchors/sensitivities
selection_data_firewall.forbidden: May/June outcomes, B0-B3 results, or post-evaluation critical cuts
